question: On fixed Boolean Weil restrictions of Semaev summation-polynomial systems, does the merged Faugere-Lachartre reducer/free-column split preserve the reduced basis and reduce exact elimination work and isolated wall time relative to the same binary's full-width cascade?

source.source_revision: the immutable commit containing this protocol; resolved and hashed by the checkpoint receipt

arms.difference: FL split forced off through a direct function parameter
FL split enabled when its frozen shape gate is satisfied

workloads.admitted_eks: Koblitz K1 over F2^17, koblitz-orbit divisor=0;1, Semaev m=2, one frozen public target
diagnostic_only: K1/F2^17 m=2: two planted and two natural targets, 16 Boolean variables
K0/F2^15 factor 1 m=3 interleaved: one planted and one natural target, 27 Boolean variables

measurement.interrupted_rows: excluded; the interruption and charge are retained

secondary: FL matrices, reducer rows, pair rows and free columns
correctness: identical reduced-basis SHA-256 in the fixed-system harness

decision_rules.correctness_gate: All paired outputs agree; any disagreement blocks every performance claim.
decision_rules.work_gate: Report a work reduction only when every admitted pair is finite and the paired geometric-mean ratio is below 1.
decision_rules.timing_gate: Report an isolated timing improvement only when at least five measured pairs survive, the 95% paired bootstrap interval is wholly below 1, and the effect exceeds both A/A noise intervals.
decision_rules.failure_rule: Timeouts, oversize exits, verification failures and missing rows are reported and never retried or silently dropped.

claim_boundary: The fixed harness establishes only the Boolean Groebner stage. The ecbench panel gives one small end-to-end Koblitz context cell. Neither establishes asymptotic ECDLP complexity, a sub-rho attack, or scaling beyond the frozen cells.

external_reference.required_action: Record msolve or M4GB version and binary SHA-256 if provisioned on the same host; otherwise report unavailable and do not substitute a native solver.
external_reference.local_probe: No msolve, M4GB or m4gb executable was present on PATH at freeze time.
